canonical_node_id: base-10 positive integer rendered without sign or leading zeros
canonicalization_rule: Strip outer whitespace only, require exactly one frozen regex match, capture the positive integer group, convert that group to canonical base-10 digits, and reject any token that matches neither pattern or would collide with another raw ID in the same source.
scientific_boundary: This is a response-blind one-to-one label normalization between frozen geometry and frozen process sources. It may relabel nodes but may not add, remove, merge or split patches. Geometry thresholds and topology remain unchanged under a bijective relabeling.
response_boundary: The two accepted response representations are frozen before response access from the two already observed non-response representations. No third form or post-open alias may be added.
pass_rule: Geometry canonical IDs and process source/destination union canonical IDs must each contain exactly 469 unique nodes and be identical sets. Source and destination canonical sets must each be subsets of geometry.
